description: Unit tests for the ReportingService component in Chromium, testing report queuing, processing, store interactions, and feature flag effects.

classes.name: ReportingServiceTest
classes.description: Test fixture for reporting service unit tests, parameterized on store usage, setting up test environment, and testing report queuing, processing, and store interactions.

methods.name: QueueReport
methods.description: Tests queuing a report with valid URL and checks report storage.

methods.name: QueueReportSanitizeUrl
methods.description: Tests URL sanitization when queuing reports with credentials and fragments.

methods.name: DontQueueReportInvalidUrl
methods.description: Ensures invalid URLs are rejected and not queued.

methods.name: QueueReportNetworkIsolationKeyDisabled
methods.description: Tests report queuing behavior when network isolation key feature is disabled.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeader
methods.description: Tests processing of report-to header and endpoint creation.

methods.name: ProcessReportingEndpointsHeader
methods.description: Tests setting reporting endpoints from header and endpoint association.

methods.name: ProcessReportingEndpointsHeaderNetworkIsolationKeyDisabled
methods.description: Tests endpoint setting with network isolation key feature disabled.

methods.name: SendReportsAndRemoveSource
methods.description: Tests sending reports and removing source, verifying report status updates.

methods.name: SendReportsAndRemoveSourceWithPendingReports
methods.description: Tests behavior when source is removed with pending reports.

methods.name: ProcessReportingEndpointsHeaderPathAbsolute
methods.description: Tests processing of absolute path endpoints in header.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeaderPathAbsolute
methods.description: Tests report-to header with absolute path endpoint.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeader_TooLong
methods.description: Ensures overly long headers are rejected.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeader_TooDeep
methods.description: Ensures overly nested headers are rejected.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeaderNetworkIsolationKeyDisabled
methods.description: Tests report-to header behavior with feature disabled.

methods.name: WriteToStore
methods.description: Verifies store commands issued during report processing and data removal.

methods.name: WaitUntilLoadFinishesBeforeWritingToStore
methods.description: Tests that store writes wait for initial load to complete.
